unitGuard.rule: For prev/sell/buy/cash-repay/balance fields, LOTS*1000 equals SHARES exactly. For limit, the margin page displays whole lots equal to floor(shareLimit/1000); preserve source-native precision.

antiSelectionBiasRules: D06-09 SBL universe must not be inner-joined to the D06-08 margin-eligible universe by default.
Y/not-credit-qualified rows are structurally absent from the margin-transactions table but can carry real SBL short balances and same-day activity.
Absence from the margin table is not zero SBL activity and not missing-data evidence for D06-09.
D06-08 and D06-09 require separate denominators and coverage counts before any cross-sectional comparison.
When comparing only common support, report the dropped SBL-only population separately.
Credit eligibility is a market-rule state, not an investor-motive label.
exactNext: Carry separate D06-08 margin-eligible and D06-09 SBL universes into every future receipt. On the next trading date verify whether the 13-row pattern persists; never infer zero SBL from margin-table absence.
